eyebrow: A dated, owned plan — not an assumption
code:
T-21 days:  request cloud quota increase          [owner: J. Alvarez]
T-14 days:  pre-warm autoscaling groups           [owner: Platform]
T-10 days:  scale DB read replicas                [owner: DBA team]
T-5 days:   event-specific load test, realistic mix [owner: SRE]
T-1 day:    dashboards + war room staffed          [owner: On-call]
caption: Every step has an owner and a date, worked backward from the event — not a verbal assumption someone will handle it.

eyebrow: Shedding load if it gets tight
code:
if capacity_utilization > 85%:
    disable("recommendation_engine")      # kill switch 1
    disable("non_critical_background_jobs") # kill switch 2
    # core checkout path keeps all capacity for itself
caption: Kill switches are built and tested before the event — not improvised live when things get tight.
